in_marathi.name: Kanaka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanaka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Kanaka means 'Golden' or 'Radiant'. This name holds significant cultural and spiritual meaning in Hindu tradition. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kanaka' meaning 'yellow' or 'gold'. The name is often given to children born during the harvest season, symbolizing the abundance and prosperity of the season. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity, is often depicted as having golden skin, further emphasizing the symbolism of the name.
